goals: Extend CNM ShapeMap families with BGE-owned geometry while preserving Nibaru-owned material identity and semantics.
Provide six-direction Layer geometry for every canonical family without changing accepted Step or Vertical behavior.
scope: Maintain BGE-owned placement, state, rendering, collision, drops, and specialized behavior for generated geometry.

Generate exactly one Layer after Step for each of 311 canonical ShapeMap families, preserving deterministic 933/933 Vertical, Step, and Layer population and guarding generated Layers from recursive Nibaru material discovery.

Preserve six-direction facing, one-through-four 4-pixel thickness, waterlogging, same-item exposed-face stacking, material pattern and axis behavior, typed DROP_BASE transitions, and profile-driven specialized semantics.

exclusions: Nibaru owns canonical material identity, visual roles, capabilities, transitions, copied settings, and material, pattern, and axis semantics.
CNM ShapeMap remains the canonical material-family and switching mechanism; BGE must not create a competing material registry or selector.
Corner geometry is frozen out of scope.
Quarter Column geometry is frozen out of scope.
BBB is reference-only; its source and assets are excluded, and BGE has no BBB dependency.
Accepted Step and Vertical behavior and Glazed production behavior remain unchanged except for migration-only path normalization.

dependencies.reason: BGE C53 consumes Nibaru C46 canonical-parent Layer and typed DROP_BASE contracts.
Fabric API used by the current C53 build and runtime implementation.
Provides the canonical ShapeMap family and geometry-switching mechanism extended by BGE.
Provides the exact Nibaru C46 material-profile and Layer contract implementation paired with C53.

state.milestone: Exact BGE C53 and its required exact Nibaru C46 contract artifact remain deployed together in Slot A with manager readiness verified. The user's runtime test recorded C53 as FAIL because compatible Layer growth in an already occupied block consumed additional source/layer items; falling-material behavior, grass lifecycle, glass/translucency, the remaining observed Layer geometry behavior, and the one-full-source-block break return were reported correct. Accepted BGE C52 and Nibaru C45 remain disabled as the rollback baseline under the slot-scoped dependency override.
